about: A terminal app that bundles everyday developer tools, like formatters and converters.

prs.title: The JSON formatter no longer changes your data
prs.broken: Formatting JSON changed the data itself: long numbers were rounded, keys were sorted, 2.50 became 2.5 and some symbols were escaped.
prs.changed: The formatter now only changes spacing and line breaks.
prs.matters: People can tidy JSON without silently altering IDs, prices or key order.

prs.title: The YAML formatter keeps comments and key order
prs.broken: Formatting a YAML file removed every comment and sorted the keys, so a config written back lost its notes.
prs.changed: The formatter now keeps comments and the original order.
prs.matters: Config files can be tidied without losing the explanations in them.

prs.title: Converting to TOML keeps whole numbers whole
prs.broken: Converting JSON or YAML to TOML wrote every number as a decimal, so 8080 became 8080.0 and large IDs lost digits.
prs.changed: Whole numbers now stay whole numbers, and decimals stay decimals.
prs.matters: Config files made with the converter load with the right types.
